_about: Known debt at the moment the rule set was fixed (2026-09-30).
A rule may not exceed its recorded count; anything above it fails the gate.
A rule that comes in below its count is reported so this file can be tightened,
and a rule that no longer appears should be deleted from this file.
Counts are per rule rather than per finding, so a fix in one file can hide a new
occurrence in another. The per-rule table printed by the runner is the audit trail.
